note: Max rank only. The simulator runs at level 60, and a talent tooltip shows rank 1 of the ability it grants -- see docs/class-implementation.md.

spells.name: Abolish Disease
spells.description: Attempts to cure 1 disease effect on the target, and 1 more disease effect every 5 seconds for 20 sec.

spells.name: Binding Heal
spells.description: Heals a friendly target and the caster for 773 to 909. Low threat.

spells.name: Chastise
spells.description: Chastise the target, causing 272 to 306 Holy damage and Immobilizing them for up to 2 sec. Only works against Humanoids. This spell causes very low threat

spells.name: Confounding Flash
spells.description: Confuses up to 5 enemies within 8 yds for 3 sec. Any damage taken will break the effect.

spells.name: Contingency Plan
spells.description: Place a Holy ward on an ally for 30 sec. The next time this ally takes damage dropping their Health below 35%, they will gain a shield absorbing 926 damage and begin healing for 670 Health over 15 sec. A target may be affected by only one Contingency Plan.

spells.name: Cure Disease
spells.description: Removes 1 disease from the friendly target.

spells.name: Dark Sacrifice
spells.description: Cannibalize 1,600 of your own Health over 15 sec to gain 1,600 Mana, plus your Spirit.

spells.name: Desperate Prayer
spells.description: Instantly heals the caster for 1,285 to 1,513.

spells.name: Devouring Plague
spells.description: Afflicts the target with a disease that causes 848 Shadow damage over 24 sec. Damage caused by the Devouring Plague heals the caster.

spells.name: Dispel Magic
spells.description: Dispels magic on the target, removing 2 harmful spells from a friend or 2 beneficial spells from an enemy.

spells.name: Divine Grace
spells.description: Instantly heals a friendly target below 50% Health for 1,285 to 1,513 and removes Weakened Soul from that target. Cannot be cast on self.

spells.name: Divine Spirit
spells.description: Holy power infuses the target, increasing their Spirit by 40 for 1 hour.

spells.name: Elune's Grace
spells.description: Reduces the chance you'll be hit by melee and ranged attacks by 50% for 15 sec or until you are missed 3 times.

spells.name: Fade
spells.description: Fade out, discouraging enemies from attacking you for 10 sec. More effective than Fade (rank 5).

spells.name: Fear Ward
spells.description: Wards the friendly target against Fear. The next Fear effect used against the target will fail, using up the ward. Lasts 3 min.

spells.name: Feedback
spells.description: The priest becomes surrounded with anti-magic energy. Any successful spell cast against the priest will burn 105 of the attacker's Mana, causing 1 Shadow damage for each point of Mana burned. Lasts 15 sec.

spells.name: Flash Heal
spells.description: Heals a friendly target for 773 to 909.

spells.name: Greater Heal
spells.description: A slow casting spell that heals a single target for 1,853 to 2,067.

spells.name: Heal
spells.description: Heal your target for 633 to 713.

spells.name: Hex of Weakness
spells.description: Weakens the target enemy, reducing melee attack power by 204 and reducing the effectiveness of any healing by 20%. Lasts 2 min

spells.name: Holy Fire
spells.description: Consumes the enemy in holy flames that cause 184 to 232 Holy damage and an additional 75 Holy damage over 10 sec.

spells.name: Holy Nova
spells.description:
Causes an explosion of holy light around the caster, causing 174 to 200 Holy damage to all enemy targets within 10 yards and healing all party members within 10 yards for 288 to 334. These effects cause no threat.

Each time Holy Fire deals damage, you have a 5% chance for your next Holy Nova to cost no Mana.

spells.name: Inner Fire
spells.description: A burst of Holy energy fills the caster, increasing armor by 1,395. Each melee or ranged damage hit against the priest will remove one charge. Lasts 10 min or until 20 charges are used.

spells.name: Inner Focus
spells.description: When activated, reduces the Mana cost of your next spell by 100% and increases its critical effect chance by 25% if it is capable of a critical effect.

spells.name: Lesser Heal
spells.description: Heal your target for 138 to 160.

spells.name: Levitate
spells.description: Allows the caster to levitate, floating a few feet above the ground. While levitating, you will fall at a reduced speed and travel over water-like surfaces. Mounting or any damage taken will cancel the effect. Lasts 2 min.

spells.name: Lightwell
spells.description: Creates a holy Lightwell near the priest. Members of your raid or party can click the Lightwell to restore 1,600 health over 10 sec. Being attacked cancels the effect. Lightwell lasts for 3 min or 5 charges.

spells.name: Mana Burn
spells.description: Drains 746 to 788 mana from a target. For each mana drained in this way, the target takes 0.5 Shadow damage.

spells.name: Mind Blast
spells.description: Blasts the target for 477 to 503 Shadow damage, but causes a high amount of threat.

spells.name: Mind Control
spells.description: Controls a humanoid mind up to level 64, but increases the time between attacks by 25%. Lasts up to 1 min.

spells.name: Mind Flay
spells.description: Assault the target's mind with Shadow energy, causing 390 Shadow damage over 3 sec and slowing their movement speed by 50%.

spells.name: Mind Soothe
spells.description: Soothes the target, reducing the range at which it will attack you by 10 yards. Only affects Humanoid targets level 70 or lower. Lasts 15 sec.

spells.name: Mind Vision
spells.description: Allows the caster to see through the target's eyes for 1 min. Will not work if the target is in another instance or on another continent.

spells.name: Penance
spells.description: Launches a volley of holy light at the target, causing 131 Holy damage to an enemy, or 673 healing to an ally, instantly and every 1 sec for 2 sec.

spells.name: Power Infusion
spells.description: Infuses the target with power, increasing their spell damage and healing done by 20% for 15 sec.

spells.name: Power Word: Fortitude
spells.description: Power infuses the target, increasing their Stamina by 70 for 1 hour.

spells.name: Power Word: Shield
spells.description: Draws on the soul of the party member to shield them, absorbing 928 damage. Lasts 30 sec. While the shield holds, spellcasting will not be interrupted by damage. Once shielded, the target cannot be shielded again for 15 sec.

spells.name: Prayer of Fortitude
spells.description: Power infuses all party and raid members, increasing their Stamina by 70 for 1 hour.

spells.name: Prayer of Healing
spells.description: A powerful prayer that heals the target and their party for 631 to 667. Party members must be within 40 yards of target.

spells.name: Prayer of Mending
spells.description: Places a spell on the target that heals them for 413 the next time they take damage or receive non-periodic healing. When the heal occurs, Prayer of Mending jumps to a party or raid member within 20 yards. Jumps up to 5 times and lasts 30 sec after each jump. This spell can only be placed on one target at a time per caster.

spells.name: Prayer of Shadow Protection
spells.description: Power infuses all party and raid members, increasing their Shadow resistance by 60 for 20 min.

spells.name: Prayer of Spirit
spells.description: Power infuses all party and raid members, increasing their Spirit by 40 for 1 hour.

spells.name: Psychic Scream
spells.description: The caster lets out a psychic scream, causing 5 enemies within 8 yards to flee for 8 sec. Damage caused may interrupt the effect.

spells.name: Renew
spells.description: Heals the target of 830 damage over 15 sec.

spells.name: Resurrection
spells.description: Brings a dead player back to life with 750 health and 1,000 mana. Cannot be cast when in combat.

spells.name: Shackle Undead
spells.description: Shackles the target undead enemy for up to 50 sec. The shackled unit is unable to move, attack or cast spells. Any damage caused will release the target. Only one target can be shackled at a time.

spells.name: Shadow Protection
spells.description: Increases the target's resistance to Shadow spells by 60 for 10 min.

spells.name: Shadow Word: Death
spells.description: A word of dark binding that inflicts 444 to 472 Shadow damage to the target. If your target is not killed by Shadow Word: Death, you take backlash damage equal to 10% of your maximum health.

spells.name: Shadow Word: Pain
spells.description: A word of darkness that causes 762 Shadow damage over 18 sec.

spells.name: Shadowform
spells.description: Assume Shadowform, increasing your Shadow damage by 10%, reducing the Mana cost of all Shadow spells by 50%, increasing the critical strike damage bonus of your Shadow spells by 100%, and reducing Physical damage taken by you by 15%. However, you may not cast healing spells while in this form.

spells.name: Shadowguard
spells.description: The caster is surrounded by shadows. When a spell, melee or ranged attack hits the caster, the attacker will be struck for 96 Shadow damage. Attackers can only be damaged once every few seconds. This damage causes no threat. 3 charges. Lasts 10 min.

spells.name: Silence
spells.description: Silences the target, preventing them from casting spells for 5 sec and interrupting their spellcasts for 3 sec.

spells.name: Smite
spells.description: Smite an enemy for 166 to 186 Holy damage.

spells.name: Starshards
spells.description: Rains starshards down on the enemy target's head, causing 1,800 Arcane damage over 6 sec.

spells.name: Touch of Weakness
spells.description: The next melee attack on the caster will cause 56 Shadow damage and reduce the attacker's melee attack power by the attacker by 204 for 2 min.

spells.name: Vampiric Embrace
spells.description: Afflicts your target with Shadow energy that causes all party members to be healed for 20% of any Shadow spell damage you deal for 30 sec. Vampiric Embrace also grants a chance for your Spirit Tap talent to trigger when enemies afflicted by it die.
